verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms https://docs.x.ai/openapi.json returns HTTP 200 and contains an 'openapi' key, i.e., a downloadable, machine-readable OpenAPI spec for the xAI API, and this is corroborated by extensive first-party API docs describing the full endpoint surface (text, images, video, tools). Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that developers actually consume this spec (e.g., via SDK codegen) beyond the automated probe.
